data.summary: High-caliber Senior Product Manager with 13+ years of experience leading product innovation and digital transformation across BFSI, payments, and insurance sectors. Expert in orchestrating end-to-end product lifecycles for Retail and Corporate Banking, with a proven ability to modernize legacy architectures into agile, customer-centric ecosystems. demonstrated success in launching high-adoption Mobile Banking apps, streamlining Digital Customer Onboarding journeys, and optimizing Loan Origination Systems (LOS) to reduce turnaround time and operational costs. Adept at bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution, delivering scalable solutions (API integrations, PAS, Digital Payments) that improved efficiency by up to 40%. A certified SAFe POPM, PMI-ACP, and PMP professional committed to driving revenue growth and regulatory compliance (PCI DSS, GDPR) through data-driven decision-making and cross-functional leadership.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
High-caliber Senior Product Manager with 13+ years of experience leading product innovation and digital transformation across BFSI, payments, and insurance sectors. Expert in orchestrating end-to-end product lifecycles for Retail and Corporate Banking, with a proven ability to modernize legacy architectures into agile, customer-centric ecosystems. demonstrated success in launching high-adoption Mobile Banking apps, streamlining Digital Customer Onboarding journeys, and optimizing Loan Origination Systems (LOS) to reduce turnaround time and operational costs. Adept at bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution, delivering scalable solutions (API integrations, PAS, Digital Payments) that improved efficiency by up to 40%. A certified SAFe POPM, PMI-ACP, and PMP professional committed to driving revenue growth and regulatory compliance (PCI DSS, GDPR) through data-driven decision-making and cross-functional leadership.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Product Strategy & Leadership: Product Vision & Roadmap Strategy • Go-to-Market (GTM) Execution • ROI & P&L Analysis • OKR Definition & KPI Tracking • Competitor Analysis & Market Research • Vendor & 3rd Party Management • Backlog Prioritization • User Story Mapping • Cross-Functional Leadership (Engineering, Sales, Compliance).
Banking & Financial Domain Expertise: Retail & Corporate Banking: Digital Customer Onboarding (eKYC/AML/Biometrics) • Loan Origination Systems (LOS) • Loan Management Systems (LMS) • Cash Management Services (CMS) • Wealth Management • Core Banking Integration.
Mobile & Digital Channels: Omni-channel Strategy • Mobile Banking (Super Apps) • Internet Banking Portals • User Experience (UX) Optimization • Customer 360 & Personalization.
Payments: Domestic & Cross-Border Payments (SWIFT, SEPA, ISO 20022, Fedwire, ACH) • Real-Time Payments • Digital Wallets & UPI • Direct Debits & Standing Instructions.
Insurance: Policy Administration Systems (PAS)- Life Asia, NGIN, ABS • Claims Automation • Underwriting Tech • Agency Portals.
Technical Product Management & Architecture: API-First Strategy & Lifecycle Management • Microservices Architecture • Cloud-Native Solutions (AWS/Azure basics) • System Integration & Data Migration • Security & Identity Management (OAuth 2.0, SSO, LDAP) • SDLC & Release Management • Technical Documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI) • Database Schema Understanding.
Agile Transformation & Governance: SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) • Scrum & Kanban Methodologies • DevOps & CI/CD Pipelines • Regulatory Compliance (GDPR, PCI DSS, PSD2, FATCA, Central Bank Reporting) • Risk Assessment & Operational Resilience • Sprint Planning & Retrospectives.
Tools & Technologies:
Management: Jira, Confluence, Rally, MS Project, Azure DevOps.
Design & Data: Figma, Visio, Balsamiq, Tableau, Power BI, Google Analytics.
Technical: Postman (API Testing), SQL (Querying), Python (Basic), JSON, XML, SOAP/REST APIs.
CRM & Core: Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Product Manager 	Oct 2024 – Present
Altimetrik Corp (Global Payments)	Bengaluru
Led the product strategy and delivery of enterprise-grade API Banking and Payment Gateway solutions, enabling seamless transaction flows for Retail Banking and Insurance partners.
API Product Roadmap: Defined the vision for a B2B Payment API Dashboard, translating complex Insurance Premium & Retail Banking workflows into technical specs (OpenAPI), reducing ambiguity by 40%.
Open Banking Architecture: Drove secure Microservices integrations between legacy banking cores and merchant platforms, reducing partner integration timelines by 30%.
Merchant Analytics: Designed Real-Time Transaction Dashboards offering operational KPIs, significantly improving decision-making efficiency for banking stakeholders.
Compliance Solutions: Implemented PCI DSS compliant billing and reconciliation workflows, reducing operational risks and overhead costs.
Delivery Excellence: Led Agile ceremonies for a 12-member team, maintaining a 95% on-time delivery rate through effective Scrum governance.
Senior Product manager	Feb 2023 – Aug 2024
Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Company	Pune
Led the digital modernization of Core Insurance Platforms, managing the transition from legacy systems to agile architectures (PAS, LMS, CRM) to enhance operational scalability and customer engagement.
PAS Transformation (Legacy Modernization): Spearheaded the strategic migration of the Policy Administration System (PAS) from OPUS to NGIN. Redesigned core policy servicing workflows, achieving a 25% reduction in turnaround time (TAT) and enabling faster time-to-market for new insurance products.
Customer 360 & Analytics: Architected a "Customer 360" data ecosystem by aggregating 500K+ customer touchpoints. Developed advanced analytics frameworks that empowered stakeholders with a unified view of the customer, driving hyper-personalized retention strategies and cross-selling opportunities.
Omnichannel Payments & AI: Integrated Conversational AI (WhatsApp Bots) and cloud-based telephony with core premium collection APIs. This "Omnichannel Payment" strategy automated the renewal collection process, significantly reducing dunning efforts and payment processing latency.
Sales Force Automation (LMS): Directed the enhancement of the Lead Management System (LMS), introducing automated lead deduplication, intelligent routing, and prospecting modules. These optimizations resulted in a 30% improvement in lead-to-quote conversion rates.
Performance Monitoring: Built robust testing frameworks and real-time operational dashboards using Tableau and SQL. Established KPI monitoring for underwriting and claims throughput, enabling data-driven operational adjustments.
Stakeholder & Scope Management: Facilitated high-impact workshops with IT, Operations, and Business heads to define project scope and deliverables. Maintained 98% User Acceptance Testing (UAT) pass rates by ensuring strict alignment between business requirements and technical execution.
Senior Product owner/ Lead Business Analyst	Feb 2018 – Feb 2023
HDFC Life (HDFC Bank)	Pune
Led digital transformation and product strategy for the Bancassurance channel, orchestrating the convergence of Retail Banking, Mobile Banking, and Insurance platforms to drive cross-sell revenue and operational efficiency.
Bancassurance Transformation: Spearheaded the integration of insurance journeys into HDFC Bank’s Mobile & Net Banking platforms, enabling "One-Click" issuance and boosting digital adoption.
Lending Integration (LOS): Orchestrated the embedding of Credit Life products within the Retail and Corporate Loan Origination System (LOS), reducing turnaround time by 40% via automated underwriting.
Payments Modernization: Redesigned payment architectures supporting e-wallets, UPI, and SWIFT/SEPA transfers, achieving a 30% increase in transaction volume and 15% cost reduction.
System Upgrades: Directed enhancements for Life Asia and ABS Policy Administration Systems, integrating APIs with TPAs for real-time claims processing and health underwriting.
Process Reengineering: Conducted gap analysis for billing and CRM workflows, implementing automation that improved operational efficiency by 45%.
Growth & Strategy: Executed GTM strategies for new banking channel products, contributing to a regional market share increase from 70% to 95%.
Leadership: Managed a cross-functional team of 12 consultants/POs, maintaining 92% productivity through rigorous Agile performance tracking.
Manager (Business Analyst)	Jan 2013 – Feb 2018
Alai Insurance and Investments (Client- HDFC)	Nashik
Digital Banking Journeys: Led requirement engineering for Retail Banking onboarding and account services, creating process maps that optimized operational workflows by 50%.
Global Payments: Analyzed requirements for cross-border payment integrations (SWIFT, SEPA, Fedwire, ACH), ensuring compliance with Indian and Global settlement regulations.
Wealth Management Strategy: Designed optimized financial portfolio products for High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs), driving a 2X increase in revenue through strategic cross-selling.
Risk & Compliance: Implemented monitoring systems for KYC/AML and payment fraud detection, ensuring product stability and regulatory adherence.
Stakeholder Management: Guided 4 Sales Managers and Agile teams, facilitating sprint planning and backlog grooming to align technical deliverables with business goals.
